409.description: The run exists but has no recorded output artifact yet.

200.description:
The run's final output value, released only over this authenticated
response channel; the public ledger records the occurrence
(`outputRevealed`) but never the value.

403.description: The signer is not the run's on-chain owner.

409.description:
The run has no recorded output, or the send envelope was already
consumed (a replayed envelope produces no new reveal event); prepare a
fresh reveal.

get.summary:
Every team whose latest version uses the given agent, so deleting that agent
can name what it would break before doing it. See `referencing_teams`.

post.summary:
Stops a published team answering mentions, by removing the record that marks
its account as a team. The account and handle are kept, so it is reversible
by publishing again.

get.summary:
Reports a team's publication as the chain records it, reconciled against
the PDS. Nothing previously compared the two, so a destroyed account left the
interface presenting a team as published with no way to notice.

post.summary:
Prepares a standing channel grant: "channel identity C may initiate
runs of team T owned by me, within caps, with the delegated
authority". The grantor signs in the environment where their key
lives; the chain derives the grantor from the deploy's signer.

422.description:
The request named a channel, authority class, or cap outside the legal
vocabulary (`grant_invalid_request`).

403.description: The signer does not hold grant authority (`grant_unauthorized`).

post.summary:
Prepares a grant revocation. Revocation is delivery-only for in-flight
runs: they complete for their owner, while the grantee's reveal and
command claims fail from the moment of revocation. The grantor keeps
`cancel` through the ordinary command envelope.

403.description: The signer does not hold grant authority (`grant_unauthorized`).

get.summary:
Grants created by a wallet, for the grant-management interface.
Revoked grants are included, flagged.

Grants naming a channel wallet as grantee. An operations cross-check:
channel services consume the observer-readable chain clause directly
and use this mirror only for diagnostics.

post.summary:
Prepares a run under a grant: the channel wallet signs and pays the
deploy, the grantor owns the run, and the chain adjudicates the grant
atomically with run registration. Durable teams only.

422.description:
The channel context does not match the grant
(`grant_principal_mismatch`), or the granted team has no durable
deployment (`team_not_durable`).

429.description: The grant's daily run cap is exhausted (`grant_caps_exceeded`).

200.description:
The run-state JSON read back from the observer after chain finality,
exactly as the plain run send returns it.

429.description: The grant's daily run cap is exhausted (`grant_caps_exceeded`).

402.description: The channel wallet could not fund the deploy (`deploy_unfunded`).

504.description:
The deploy was accepted but finality was not observed in time
(`deploy_not_finalized`); the run may still complete -- poll the run
state.

post.summary:
Prepares a mail binding: `local@domain` recognized by the mail
channel, bound on chain to the team's deployed registry URI. The
prepare is side-effect light -- a pure render plus a uniqueness read
-- and the binding carries no key material.

404.description: The team does not exist under the address (`team_not_found`).

409.description:
The address is already actively bound to a different team
(`binding_duplicate`).

422.description:
The address fails the grammar (`invalid_mail_address`), or the team
has no deployment to bind (`team_not_deployed`).

409.description:
The address is already actively bound to a different team
(`binding_duplicate`).

403.description: The signer does not own the team (`binding_unauthorized`).

404.description: No active binding exists (`binding_not_found`); unpublish only.

post.summary:
Prepares deactivation of the team's mail binding. Reversible: the
binding record is kept and publishing again reactivates the address.

404.description: No active mail binding exists for the team (`binding_not_found`).

409.description:
The address is already actively bound to a different team
(`binding_duplicate`).

403.description: The signer does not own the team (`binding_unauthorized`).

404.description: No active binding exists (`binding_not_found`); unpublish only.

get.summary:
Where the team is reachable, per channel, with honestly three-valued
reachability. Mail reachability is never asserted (embers does not
probe SMTP); chat reachability is derived from grant presence.

Every binding for a channel, an HTTP mirror of the observer-readable
chain clause for UI and operations.

PublishedState.title: PublishedState
PublishedState.description:
Whether a team is published to F1R3SKY, and whether the account it was
published under is still there.

`account_exists` is deliberately three-valued. `Some(false)` is a real
divergence — the chain records a publication whose account has been destroyed,
which is what a wiped development PDS leaves behind. `None` means the question
could not be answered, from an unreachable PDS or a publish recorded before
handles were captured, and must not be presented as though the account were
missing.

the question could not be answered.

A client-signed contract, ready to deploy: the send phase of the two-phase
protocol carries it, and the chain is the verifier of record.

sig_algorithm.description: The signature algorithm; the platform signs with `secp256k1`.
